title: docs(agents): adopt AGENTS.md — repository-specific base rules, incidents and gate commands
intent: Adopt an AGENTS.md in this repository: the universal branch-from-main and merge-don't-rebase rules, this repo's own witnessed stale-base incidents, and the real verification-gate commands with the working directory each runs from. This is the ADOPTION decision, deliberately kept separate from SCAFFOLD-DIST-001 (#368), which distributed the scaffolder, its self-test and the CI pin but wrote no AGENTS.md. Documentation only: one new file, no source, no CI, no schema.

diff_articulation.what_changed: Adds AGENTS.md (150 lines) at the repository root. Universal sections are the scaffolder's verbatim output; the two repository-specific blocks the scaffolder deliberately refuses to write are filled by hand. INCIDENTS carries this repository's witnessed stale-base failures. VERIFICATION GATES carries the gate commands copied from the workflow files, each annotated with the working directory it must run from, plus the CBSP21 per-PR manifest requirement introduced by #352.
diff_articulation.why_not_redundant: No AGENTS.md exists on main — verified with git ls-tree (not a ref:path check, which mangles under MSYS and produced a false negative earlier in this work). #368 landed the scaffolder and its self-test but wrote no AGENTS.md, by design: distributing the tool and adopting its output are separate decisions. The content is not generic advice — it records a per-gate working-directory hazard, the PowerShell glob-expansion difference that makes a copied CI command fail locally, and the post-#352 rule that a manifest belonging to another change can no longer satisfy this PR.
